steps.title: Bem-vindo: Daily Life - Volume 1
steps.text: In this A1-level lesson, we'll explore essential vocabulary and phrases about "Daily Life". Get ready to level up your real-world communication skills!

words.example: I have a simple morning routine.
We waited in line for twenty minutes.
I didn't hear my alarm clock this morning.

steps.title: Idiom: Bite the bullet
steps.text: It means: "To face a difficult situation with courage.". Say the example sentence out loud:
steps.targetPhrase: I hate going to the dentist, but I'll just have to bite the bullet.
